# The engine reads its .tex files straight into a CPU_UNCACHED | GPU_CACHED | COMPRESSIBLE pool (flags 0xa2) after creating the textures: 231 textures by the title screen, no packaged layout,
# no WriteTexels, no copies, and writes to an uncached pool need no flush. tex_dirty_upload uploads a registered texture whose pages the CPU wrote after nvnTextureInitialize; without both
# keys every texture read 0 and the screen stayed black

# the rewritten modules (76 MB with the bss) are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory the game takes off the pool for its heap
